articles.headline: England's Reece James misses training ahead of Panama World Cup clash
articles.description: Reece James missed training ahead of England's final group game against Panama.

articles.headline: Sources: Norway's Erling Haaland to miss France World Cup clash
articles.description: Erling Haaland will start Norway's World Cup Group I clash against Kylian Mbappe's France on the substitutes' bench with coach Stale Solbakken planning to rest ten players, sources have told ESPN.

articles.description: We continue with the final days of the 2026 FIFA World Cup group stage as we figure out who will qualify for the knockout stage.

articles.headline: Ghana's players are fully on board with 'father' Carlos Queiroz and his defensive style
articles.description: Ghana are one of only four teams -- along with Mexico, Argentina and Spain -- not to concede in their two opening World Cup games, despite facing 30 shots across their matches and using two goalkeepers.

articles.headline: Ronwen Williams pays tribute to past Bafana greats after South Korea win
articles.description: Ronwen Williams said that although he was the first captain of a Bafana team which made the World Cup knockout rounds, past icons paved the way.
